title: comptime evaluation cannot observe the network: the ambient fetch binding is unreachable
notes: specification/comptime.mdx, 'Determinism': comptime 'MUST NOT observe ambient ... network state', and 'Comptime I/O': 'Arbitrary unavailable runtime I/O MUST NOT be performed merely because a call occurs beneath comptime.' `fetch` is the one network entry point present in every supported host, so it is the ambient spelling this case pins.

xfail.reason: the fork reports VIBE1403@3:7 (a started-Promise consumption charge against the binding that holds the comptime call) beside the comptime refusal VCT1004@3:29 — the same missing stage short-circuit as the-filesystem-is-unreachable-from-comptime's marker: the reference reports the comptime refusal alone.
xfail.doc: conformance/README.md 'Acceptance is the frontend's own acceptance, in ordered stages'; specification/comptime.mdx 'Determinism' and 'Comptime I/O' are the rules under test.
